description: VE11C parameter labels that later releases renamed. Only one-to-one renames belong here. A parameter that a later release split into two, or merged with another, is not a rename and is better left visible as an add plus a remove.

notes.B0 Shim mode: Values agree exactly (Standard, Tune up). Not to be confused with XA60's separate Adjustment Strategy.
notes.Coil Select Mode: Same setting, but the value vocabulary was recoded (Off - All -> Auto Coil Select / Manual), so values still report as changed.
notes.Load images to viewer: The viewer itself was renamed to MR View&GO.
notes.PAT mode: XA60 renames parallel acceleration to Acc/Acceleration. Values agree exactly (GRAPPA, None).

rejected.Reference scan mode -> Reference Scans: Not a rename: XA60 keeps 'Reference scan mode' for Single-shot and adds 'Reference Scans' for the rest. Mapping it steals the exact match that already works for the larger group.
rejected.Prescan Normalize -> Normalize: Not a rename: XA60 merged VE11C's separate 'Normalize' and 'Prescan Normalize' into one parameter whose 'Prescan' value covers the old 'Prescan Normalize: On'.
rejected.Fat suppr. -> Fat-Water Contrast: Related but not one to one: 110 readings against 66, and XA60 also carries a separate 'Fat Saturation'. Left visible rather than guessed at.
